meta.title: Squad Up | Instant group scheduling
meta.description: Find the best time and place for your gathering in minutes. Share one link on LINE or Discord, tap your free days and vote.

home.heroTitle: Squad up in a snap — pick the day, pick the place.
home.heroSubtitle: Create a gathering, share one link, and watch everyone's free days light up.
home.createCta: I'm the host · Start a gathering
home.joinInvalid: That doesn't look like a gathering code or link.
home.f1Body: Greener days mean more friends are free. The best slots rise to the top.
home.f2Body: Offer up to 3 spots and let everyone choose with a single tap.
home.f3Body: Share to LINE, Discord or Telegram. Friends join without an account.

create.pageSubtitle: Fill in the basics. You can share the link right after.
create.nicknameHint: Saved on this device so you can edit later.
create.locationsHint: Up to 3. With two or more, everyone votes. With one, it's shown as fixed.
create.spotsGuestHint: Sign in with Google to save favourite meetup spots and MRT stations for one-tap autofill.
create.slotHourlyHint: One slot per hour inside the window you choose.
create.capacityHint: 1–20 people, including you. You take one seat automatically.
create.expiryHintGuest: Guests can choose 3, 5 or 7 days. Sign in to extend up to 30 days.
create.expiryHintMember: Members can keep a link for up to 30 days.
create.memberExpiryHint: Sign in with Google to extend the link up to 30 days.
create.passcodeHint: 3–8 characters. Friends must enter it before seeing the room.
create.guestNote: Tip: hosts who sign in with Google can remove participants and finalize the plan.
